normalization_rules: read the Symbol CSV column as text
selection_algorithm: For every normalized unique symbol not in excluded_seen_symbols, calculate lowercase hexadecimal SHA256(UTF-8('quant_research_holdout_v1:' + symbol)); sort ascending by hash with symbol as a deterministic tie-breaker; select the first 30. No market data, data quality, metadata, or strategy result is consulted.
replacement_policy: Selected symbols are never replaced because of acquisition, history, or data-quality outcomes.
source_provenance_limitation: The upstream origin of 0.0 list.csv is UNKNOWN. It is a modern symbol snapshot, not point-in-time constituent history.
